headline: AI shrinks first-rung jobs, but opportunities exist
claim: AI is making it harder for young workers to start white-collar careers.
notes: published 2026-11-23 (byline); covers the RAISE US / Burning Glass Institute report 'Fewer Rungs, New Bridges'; article hedges that AI has not caused widespread job losses and the report lists interest rates and unwinding pandemic-era hiring as other possible causes

headline: AI is squeezing entry-level office jobs, and workers without degrees are most exposed
claim: AI is making it harder for young workers to start white-collar careers.
notes: published 2026-11-23; covers the RAISE US / Burning Glass Institute report 'Fewer Rungs, New Bridges'; report authors say the missing white-collar workers were not hired rather than laid off, and list interest rates and pandemic-era hiring unwinding as other possible factors
